question: At what temperature (in degree Celsius) is milk heated for 15 to 30 seconds to kill microbes in the pasteurisation method?
solution:
The correct answer is __**70.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pasteurisation:-**

 
 
• **It is a process of heating milk to a specific temperature for a certain period of time to kill harmful microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, and molds.**
 
• The temperature at which milk is heated during pasteurisation varies depending on the method used. In the high-temperature short-time (HTST) method, milk is heated to 72undefinedC (161undefinedF) for 15-30 seconds to kill most bacteria. In the ultra-high-temperature (UHT) method, milk is heated to 135undefinedC (275undefinedF) for a few seconds to kill all microorganisms.
